description: KNaGdNbO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.88 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are four shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond length. Gd is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Gd-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. Nb is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.88 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom to form distorted OK₄NaNb octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra, corners with eight equivalent ONaGd₂Nb tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Gd, and one Nb atom to form distorted ONaGd₂Nb tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra, corners with ten equivalent ONaGd₂Nb tetrahedra, and edges with five equivalent ONaGd₂Nb tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 70-72°.
